explanation: The theorem states that two library-specific maps (unitriangularStageFromGL and unitriangularStageToGL, between algebra homs out of a quotient of the GL coordinate ring and the unitriangular stage) are mutually inverse. Both maps are defined in this library. The statement's content is in those definitions, and the proof reduces to the library's own unitriangularFromGL_toGL via Ideal.Quotient.algHom_ext. Mathlib has no matching declaration. I did not run searches of the Mathlib directories, so this rests on the statement's form.
